verdict.rationale: Figma documents a first-party Plugin API with read and write access to the editors, plugins that run directly or through custom UI, and multiplayer widgets. Private plugins and widgets give a distribution path, and the developer llms.txt confirms the Plugin API docs exist. missing for 10: evidence of Plugin API TypeScript typings (the typings cited cover only the REST API), sample/starter plugins, public distribution or publishing workflow details, independent hands-on corroboration.
